card.description:
**Position Title:**
Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

**Location:**
Milwaukee, WI

**Position Summary:**

*Join a rapidly growing and market leading manufacturer as the Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering. Under the direction of and reporting to the VP of Manufacturing, the Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the Manufacturing Engineering function and is accountable for five connected processes:*

* *Standard documentation and engineering change order (ECO) execution*
* *Manufacturing process and technology development in support of New Product Development (NPD), ensuring new products are designed for scalable, repeatable manufacturing*
* *Core technology capital equipment life cycle strategy, including the multi-year roadmap for acquiring, standardizing, deploying, and retiring manufacturing equipment for forming and finishing*
* *Manufacturing system design (MSD) including layout, line balance, material flow, and cell design*
* *Sustainment engineering in support of the value streams.*

*Core technology and MSD are developed in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing, and sustainment priorities are set with the Director of Manufacturing and the value stream leaders. The role leads the Manufacturing Team and partners with Design Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Maintenance/Continuous Improvement.*

**Responsibilities:**

Engineering Change Order (ECO) Execution & Engineering Process Standards

* Own execution of the engineering change order (ECO) process end to end — intake, cross-functional impact review, approval routing, and implementation and cutover tracking — across fabrication and assembly, delivered through the Manager, NPD & Standard Documentation and the ECO resources reporting to that manager.
* Define and maintain manufacturing engineering process standards (BOM, routing, and work-instruction data integrity; drawing and specification standards; standard work definitions) and ensure they are consistently applied across value streams.
* Partner with Value Stream/Area Managers on the floor to ensure engineering standards are followed and gaps are closed, including standard-work sustainment audits, with sustaining engineers providing technical support through the Sustainment Lead.
* Participate in engineering design reviews; evaluate and approve standards for drawings, routings, specifications, and other manufacturing engineering documents.
* Provide the engineering-standards backbone that CI initiatives draw on when Value Stream/Area Managers and sustaining engineers pursue process improvements.

New Product Manufacturing Process Development

* Serve as the manufacturing engineering technology lead within the SOP-2 stage-gate process for new product programs, with primary focus on Phases P0–P2 (Business Case, Concept Design, Design Verification) — evaluating process technology options, make/buy decisions, and automation feasibility ahead of Beta Build — delivered through the Manager, NPD and the NPD engineers.
* Partner with Design Engineering during concept and design verification to ensure new products are designed for manufacturability (DFM/DFA), influencing product design before it is locked.
* Lead process and technology piloting, proof-of-concept builds, and equipment trials for new products, validating manufacturing feasibility and supporting Beta Build (P3), Production Readiness (P4), launch, and ramp to rate; hand off to sustainment engineering and the Value Stream/Area Manager for ownership after launch.
* Own the manufacturing readiness input to the P2 CapEx approval gate — defining the equipment, tooling, and automation investment required to support each new product launch, and building the business case with Finance.
* Represent Advanced Manufacturing Engineering at QRB/PRB stage-gate reviews, ensuring manufacturing technology risk is surfaced and mitigated early in the program.

Capital Equipment Life Cycle Planning

* Develop and maintain a multi-year capital equipment roadmap for forming and finishing across fabrication and assembly, aligned to the product roadmap, capacity plan, and overall plant strategy, in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing.
* Own the technical scope and justification for Capital Authorization Requests (CARs), partnering with Finance and plant leadership on prioritization, ROI, and total cost of ownership.
* Define an equipment standardization strategy to reduce total cost of ownership, spare-parts complexity, and technician training burden across the equipment fleet.
* Plan equipment replacement, upgrade, and end-of-life timing using Operational Availability (OA) trends, maintenance cost history, and technology obsolescence risk.
* Partner with Maintenance and Continuous Improvement on the Capital Equipment OA dashboards to identify chronically underperforming assets and translate the trend data into replacement, rebuild, or upgrade decisions.
* Direct capital project execution — technology selection, specification, supplier management, factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), installation, and equipment support for lasers, presses, and controls — through the Manager, Core Technology and the forming/finishing engineers, controls engineer, and capital equipment technicians.
* Manage the Manufacturing Engineering department budget, including advanced engineering and capital planning activities and tracking actual capital spend against the annual operating plan (AOP) capital budget; support post-installation return reviews on major capital projects.

Manufacturing System Design (MSD)

* Own factory flow design — layout, line balance, material flow, and cell design — and the standard design methodology used across the value streams, developed in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing.
* Assign MSD leadership to a designated senior forming/finishing engineer under the Manager, Core Technology, and review whether dedicated MSD headcount is warranted once the workload is visible.
* Drive adoption of MSD design standards and measure results in throughput and space and labor productivity.

Sustainment Engineering (Value Stream Support)

* Own sustainment engineering for the three value streams — process stability, yield, scrap, cost-down, problem solving, and repeat-issue closure —sustaining engineers, with a dotted-line relationship to each value stream leader.
* Set sustainment priorities with the Director of Manufacturing and the value stream leaders, and decide the allocation of engineering capacity between project work and reactive support so that project time is protected.

Advanced Manufacturing Technology & Automation

* Evaluate and recommend automation, robotics, and advanced fabrication/joining technology (e.g., laser welding, automated assembly cells) to advance Company’s manufacturing capability.
* Build technology pilots and investment business cases for automation projects, then partner with the responsible Value Stream/Area Manager on implementation and sustaining support once deployed.
* Benchmark Company’s manufacturing technology against industry best practice and maintain awareness of emerging capital equipment technology relevant to the company's product lines.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance

* Lead, coach, and develop the Manufacturing Engineering team providing project management leadership through those leaders and cross-functional project teams; build succession depth for each process.
* Own a single process model across the five processes and its handoff chain — NPD, then MSD, then core technology (installation), then sustainment after launch — with ECO supporting all four; publish decision rights and the handoff model with the VP of Manufacturing, the Director of Manufacturing, and the Director of Continuous Improvement.
* Partner with Product Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance on stage-gate reviews, launches, prioritization, and risk reviews, and represent manufacturing in design decisions (DFM/DFA) and cost targets.
* Support ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 requirements for new equipment qualification and process validation (PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans) on new capital assets and ECOs.
* Follow company manufacturing best practices — Standard Work, Visual Factory, and 5S — when deploying new processes, equipment, and engineering changes.

**Key Performance Measures:**

* ECO cycle time (submission to implementation) and engineering process standards compliance across value streams.
* On-time delivery of manufacturing readiness milestones at each NPD stage gate (P0–P3).
* Operational Availability (OA) trend for newly deployed and recently replaced capital assets.
* Capital plan adherence — actual spend vs. AOP capital budget, and realized ROI on major capital projects.
* Reduction in unplanned downtime and total cost of ownership across the managed equipment portfolio.
* Sustainment results across the value streams - first-pass yield, scrap, cost-down delivered, and repeat issue closure.
* Throughput and space and labor productivity gains from manufacturing system design projects.
* Team health - retention, succession coverage, and engagement.
* Number of automation/technology pilots successfully converted to full production deployment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or related field); 12+ years in manufacturing/process engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams with budget responsibility, and demonstrated leadership of capital equipment, automation, and engineering change management.
* Proven experience leading new product introduction from a manufacturing engineering perspective — DFM/DFA, process validation, PPAP — within a stage-gate NPD process.
* Direct experience owning an engineering change order (ECO) process and manufacturing engineering data/process standards (BOM, routing, work instructions).
* Strong background evaluating, specifying, and financially justifying capital equipment investment and managing a capital portfolio (business cases, ROI, total cost of ownership, Operational Availability).
* Familiarity with automation and robotics technology in fabrication or assembly environments; experience with laser cutting, forming, and welding automation a plus.
* Lean manufacturing / continuous improvement experience in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing system design, layout, line balance, cell design, and standard work.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.
 
 
This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation’s space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.
 
 
As Plant Manager, you will lead site operations and transform business objectives, customer commitments, and production requirements into an integrated operating plan. You will drive cross-functional execution across manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, quality, safety, and support functions while developing organizational capability and delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and operational performance.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Leads Operations, Engineering, Master Scheduling, Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, and Quality, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and ownership across the site.
* Translates revenue plans, customer demand, and business objectives into integrated operating plans aligned with labor, capacity, equipment, materials, technical resources, and infrastructure.
* Drives manufacturing execution to meet production schedules and customer requirements while improving On-Time Delivery (OTD), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), utilization, productivity, throughput, and cost performance.
* Identifies operational constraints, risks, and resource gaps, and leads cross-functional recovery plans to protect customer commitments and revenue objectives.
* Aligns Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, and Master Scheduling to maintain production-ready processes, tooling, equipment, work instructions, and schedules.
* Leads implementation of engineering changes, new product introductions, process improvements, and capital and facility projects while minimizing disruption to operations.
* Oversees facilities, utilities, and equipment reliability through preventive and predictive maintenance programs, work order management, and performance monitoring.
* Owns site safety and environmental performance, including regulatory compliance, incident investigations, corrective actions, and Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP) execution.
* Leads the Quality function and maintains the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Partners with Program Management, Business Development, Finance, and Human Resources to support customer commitments, workforce planning, Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP), leadership development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
* 10+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment with progressive leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple manufacturing and operational functions, including Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, and Quality.
* Proven ability to translate business objectives and revenue targets into operational execution plans.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, master scheduling, capacity management, and manufacturing execution.
* Demonstrated experience managing operational performance metrics, including On-Time Delivery (OTD), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), utilization, safety, and quality.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, build organizational accountability, and make data-driven operational decisions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and business skills.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Salary Range
 
 
$168,000 - $252,000 USD
 
 
Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

card.description:
LISI AEROSPACE is ranked 60th in the global aerospace value chain and specializes in the design and manufacture of high-tech metal components to enhance aircraft safety and performance. Active since 1950 in the fastener market (no. 3 worldwide), LISI AEROSPACE has been a recognized player in metal components for aircraft engines and airframes since 2011. With its dedication to industrial excellence, LISI AEROSPACE aims to become a leader in costs, quality, deadlines and workplace safety. This mindset is represented at every level of our company and by all of our team members. At LISI AEROSPACE, we focus above all on advancement and flexibility. Every employee is empowered and has the latitude they need to carry out their assignments and develop their skills. We provide this mobility and training through our Corporate University, the LISI Knowledge Institute (LKI). As a result, our company is growing fast and always welcoming new talents.
 
 
**COMPENSATION:**
$160,000.00 - $200,000.00 annually
 
 
**SCHEDULE**
: 4/9 + 4
 
 
**Summary**
The Director of Manufacturing is responsible for production, delivery and quality of highly engineered aerospace fasteners, utilizing machining, forging, thermal treatment and coating operations. In addition to these responsibilities, the Director of Manufacturing will also be responsible for safety, environmental results, efficiencies and effectiveness of the assigned production unit and/or groups. The individual will act as a senior management representative in the assigned production units and ensure that company policies and guidelines are accurately interpreted and implemented. Develops and implements optimal, cost-effective manufacturing processes and methods in accordance with product specifications and quality standards. Minimize process variation and maximize efficiency of both existing and new product manufacturing process.
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodation for disabilities may be made for one or more of the following:
 
 

* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for profit and loss results as established for the assigned production units by the organization’s budget or forecast process.
* Responsible for achieving and sustaining agreed health and safety goals while using effective management techniques to communicate goals, corrective action and create an environment of best-in-class safety practices.
* Responsible for the manufacturing and planning of best-in-class products in the assigned factory, utilizing world class techniques, clear achievable goals that align with the corporate business strategy.
* Ensure customer service levels are met and that delivery/quality Key Production Indicators (KPI) are tracked and communicated.
* Responsible for staff development, assessments, and ensuring new team members selected to join the organization have the training and development necessary to integrate them into our continuous improvement culture.
* Establishes goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPI) to assigned production units to be flowed down from P&L, HSE, Customer Service Performance, and Quality goals that are communicated and tracked on a regular basis to ensure production group activity aligns with production unit goals.
* Works with inter-departmental or cross functional staff to resolve issues with machinery, product quality, product development, Health, Safety, and Environmental, and continuous improvement.
* Develops, implements, and tracks clear action plans to improve agreed upon deficiencies with the use of problem-solving techniques, such as 8D corrective actions, statistics, capability studies (SPC), Total Preventative Maintenance (TPM).
* Plans and develops capital equipment forecasts using input from others, in order to achieve safety improvements, increased productivity, and optimizes our core skills.
* Manages professional and non-professional staff to achieve their goals through goal setting, performance appraisals, counseling, and team building.
* Must be able to prioritize and manage resources to achieve projects results even when time and/or resources are constrained.
* Ensure quality management system is adhered to and improved as a part of our continuous improvement effort.
* Organize and maintain high standards of performance, quality and customer service within all departments.
* Responsible for implementing company policies and guidelines as prescribed by management
* Supports, leads, and adheres to all business accreditations, such as AS9100, ISO14001, and others as acquired or required.
* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for and ensuring that all employees attend all training provided and for adhering to all HSE procedures, policies, and plans, conforming to reporting requirements, and safe operating procedures at all times.
* Responsible for ensuring employees in assigned area are aware of their requirement to bring any known or suspected nonconformance for all company procedures or legal requirements to management’s attention immediately.

**Ways Of Working, Experience, And Behaviors**
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
 
 

* Analytical – Ability to analyze and understand complex information, product specification, and critical technical information. Able to resolve complex problems to resolution. Able to scrutinize information providing direction and guidance on risks, strategy, planning, and actions
* Technical Skills – Technical knowledge including but not limited, to specification interpretation, product application, product quality, quality systems, International Standards, safety and environmental management, customer relationship management, project management, Lean concepts, Six-Sigma, and people development and leadership.
* Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens intently to others and seeks clarification; Provides clear and pleasant responses to inquiries regardless of the situation; Presents complex concepts in a simple manner to achieve understanding at all levels of the organization. Demonstrates group presentation skills working in a global environment; actively participates in meetings providing clear information.
* Written Communication – Writes documents clearly and accurately. Transfers production data into meaningful written documents that can be understood by all levels of the organization. Writes comprehensive well-developed policies and work instructions. Writes clear actions and audit reports.
* Teamwork - As management Team Member must lead by example, adhere and apply all company and legal regulations. Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Places success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed; Follows the company guiding principles and values; Recognizes accomplishments of team members.
* Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns actions and department activities and action plans to mission, vision and strategic goals.

card.description:
**Role Description**
The Director of Continuous Improvement is a full-time remote role responsible for leading enterprise-wide initiatives that enhance processes, performance, and overall operational effectiveness. This role oversees the design, implementation, and governance of continuous improvement frameworks, partnering with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, set priorities, and execute improvement roadmaps. Day-to-day activities include analyzing operational data, facilitating workshops, mapping and redesigning processes, and mentoring teams in continuous improvement methodologies. The Director will establish metrics, track progress against key performance indicators, and ensure that improvements are sustained through standardized practices and change management. This role also involves communicating findings and recommendations to senior leadership, aligning initiatives with strategic goals, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in Business Process Improvement and Process Improvement, with a track record of designing, implementing, and sustaining high-impact initiatives.
* Proven experience in Operational Excellence, including the use of frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) to improve quality, efficiency, and consistency.
* Advanced Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret complex data, develop insights, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated capability in Operations Management, including cross-functional collaboration and oversight of end-to-end processes.
* Experience leading change in remote or distributed teams, with strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Background in developing and tracking performance metrics, dashboards, and continuous improvement KPIs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt) are beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, and maintain a strategic, outcome-focused mindset.

card.description:
**Who we are?**
As the world's largest organization of board-certified pathologists and leading provider of laboratory accreditation and proficiency testing programs, the College of American Pathologists (CAP) serves patients, pathologists, and the public by fostering and advocating excellence in the practice of pathology and laboratory medicine worldwide.
 
 
**Our Culture**

* CAP employees make a meaningful difference by partnering with colleagues customers and members on challenging and rewarding work
* CAP provides its employees with an energetic and collaborative work environment and encourage opportunities to further develop their skills—offering reimbursement for educational programs and participation in events that enhance your skills
* We offer a generous compensation and benefits package, 401K, and more -- visit Careers at the CAP for more details

Brief Description
 
 
The Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement is accountable for optimizing the end-to-end flow of work across the Supply Chain & Logistics function, including order management, procurement, planning, fulfillment, distribution, and logistics, from order receipt through customer delivery. The role streamlines and simplifies work, establishes process ownership and decision rights, clarifies roles and responsibilities, designs reliable handovers, and improves on-time delivery and temperature integrity through data, cross-functional leadership, and employee coaching.
 
 
Specific Duties
 
 

* Provides enterprise-wide matrix leadership to process owners, functional leaders, operations managers, and cross-functional transformation teams.
* Establishes accountability for outcomes, milestones, financial benefits, risk mitigation, and sustainment across a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
* Coaches senior leaders, managers, professional staff, and frontline employees in Lean, Lean Six Sigma, structured problem solving, change leadership, and daily management.
* May lead direct reports, contractors, consultants, or dedicated project resources as the transformation portfolio evolves.
* Develop and execute a multi-year Supply Chain & Logistics continuous improvement and operational excellence strategy aligned with enterprise customer, financial, quality, and service objectives.
* Own the Supply Chain & Logistics transformation portfolio: identify opportunities, size value, prioritize initiatives, define resource requirements, and govern delivery to scope, schedule, budget, risk, and targeted benefits.
* Lead end-to-end supply chain value-stream redesign across order management, procurement, planning, fulfillment, distribution, logistics, customer service, quality, and enabling functions.
* Establish process ownership, decision rights, escalation paths, governance forums, RACI frameworks, standard work, controls, and reliable handovers.
* Create an enterprise performance-management system and single source of truth for OTIF, temperature excursions, productivity, cost, handover defects, and customer-impact measures.
* Build executive-ready business cases for process, automation, analytics, and technology investments; partner with Finance to validate baselines, track realized value, and prevent benefit leakage.
* Lead complex Lean, A3, kaizen, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving initiatives that resolve systemic constraints and deliver sustained results.
* Sponsor digital process improvement using D365, WMS, TMS, workflow automation, Power BI/Tableau, and other enterprise platforms where appropriate.
* Build organizational capability through leader standard work, training, coaching, certification pathways, communities of practice, and succession development.
* Lead change-management and stakeholder-engagement plans that drive adoption, accountability, and sustained behavioral change.
* Partner with Quality, Customer Service, Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Human Resources, cold-packaging teams, suppliers, technology partners, and external carriers.
* Present portfolio performance, financial impact, risks, decisions, and recommendations to executive leadership and governance forums.

Source of Supervision
 
 
The Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement is a seasoned supply chain and operations excellence leader accountable for creating measurable enterprise value by improving the end-to-end flow of work across Supply Chain & Logistics and the broader value chain, from order receipt through customer delivery. This role owns the continuous improvement operating system and process governance for Supply Chain & Logistics, while leading a portfolio of high-impact cross-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, service reliability, quality, temperature integrity, productivity, working capital, and cost. The Director partners with executive and functional leaders to translate supply chain and logistics strategy into scalable processes, clear decision rights, disciplined execution, and sustained financial and operational results.
 
 
Education / Experience
 
 

* Expert-level knowledge and practitioner of Lean, operational excellence, supply chain value-stream management, process governance, and structured problem solving.
* Demonstrated record of leading supply chain, logistics, or enterprise-scale transformations and delivering measurable improvements in customer service, quality, productivity, cycle time, cost, working capital, and operational resilience.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, investment prioritization, benefit validation, sensitivity analysis, and executive-level performance reporting.
* Advanced analytical capability using data modeling, dashboards, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable tools to convert complex data into decisions and action.
* Proven ability to influence executives and functional leaders without direct authority in a complex, matrixed, and regulated environment.
* Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, change leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Preferred: Experience with D365, WMS, TMS, workflow automation, process mining, and regulated, laboratory, life-sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics-distribution, or cold-chain operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Industrial or Systems Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field required; master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced education preferred.
* Twelve or more years of progressive experience in operational excellence, process transformation, and continuous improvement.
* Seven or more years leading teams, enterprise programs, or complex cross-functional transformation portfolios with executive visibility and measurable financial and operational outcomes.
* Experience partnering with Finance to validate benefits and with IT to deliver process-enabled digital transformation strongly preferred.
* Experience in laboratory, life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics distribution, cold chain, or another quality-driven and regulated environment preferred.

Additional Criteria
 
 
**This position requires candidates to live within 75-miles of Northfield, IL and meet in office requirements.**
**Salary:**
$138,000 - $176,000

Office Environment

card.description:
**Position Title:**
Director of Operational Excellence

**Reports To:**
VP Operational Excellence

**Department:**
Operational Excellence

**Status:**
Exempt

**Date:**
November 2026

**Broad Functions:**

The Director of Operational Excellence leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of the Operational Excellence (OPEX) program across all restaurants. This role oversees the Operational Excellence Manager(s) and serves as a strategic partner to operations leadership, including Regional Vice Presidents (RVPs), and to the other departments within the OPEX team, such as the beverage, culinary and training teams. The Director owns the New Restaurant Opening (NRO) process from planning through post-opening, setting the opening timeline and holding all departments accountable to it. As the owner of the OPEX program, this individual sets the standards, audit form, and scorecard; analyzes results to identify trends; and drives company-wide action plans that raise performance.

The role is accountable to partner with operations for brand, service, safety, and health standards in every locations, so that each location gives guests a consistent brand experience and warm, attentive hospitality, keeps associates and guests safe, and meets all food safety and sanitation requirements. Additionally, this role is responsible for the evolution and modernization of the OPEX program leveraging technology and measurable operational and financial improvements. The role works collaboratively with other departments, including CrunchTime, Procurement, IT, and Finance, to align priorities, manage rollouts, and drive consistent, high-quality operations across all restaurants.

**Main Duties and Responsibilities:**

1. Directs, coaches, and develops the Operational Excellence Manager(s), setting clear priorities, performance expectations and accountability while building team capability.
2. Develops and executes the annual OPEX strategy and roadmap in partnership with the VP Operational Excellence, aligning goals with company priorities and operational needs.
3. Identify opportunities for improvement and introducing new initiatives in partnership with the VP of Operational Excellence
4. Owns the OPEX program, audit form, and scorecard, reviewing and updating standards regularly so they reflect brand priorities and drive measurable results.
5. Manage the operational scorecard including the following metrics: labor, inventory accuracy, guest experience and operational compliance
6. Oversees the Operational Excellence and New Restaurant Opening calls, ensuring agendas, action items, and follow-ups drive accountability across all departments.
7. Owns the New Restaurant Opening process and calendar, setting timelines, assigning Opening Coordinators, and holding all departments accountable to opening deliverables and post-opening performance.
8. This position is responsible for opening operational readiness and hands-on training support for hourly associates in collaboration with the training department and post-opening follow-up coordinating with Construction, Operations, Culinary, IT, Procurement, Marketing and Training.
9. Partners with Regional Vice Presidents (RVPs) and operations leaders to identify performance gaps and build action plans, using the OPEX program as the roadmap.
10. Analyzes audit, scorecard, and performance data to identify trends, root causes, and best practices, and presents findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
11. Leads the planning and rollout of company-wide initiatives in partnership with the beverage team, Training, CrunchTime, Procurement, IT, and Finance, including timelines, communication, and post-rollout follow-up.
12. Partners with the Training team to align training programs and initiatives, such as BATB, micros training, with OPEX standards particularly during new restaurant openings.
13. Champions brand standards across all locations, so that every guest gets a consistent, high-quality experience that reflects the brand's identity and values.
14. Sets and oversees execution of safety programs so all restaurants follow company, local, state, and federal safety standards, ensuring risks are identified and corrective actions are put in place to protect associates and guests while working with the Loss Prevention department.
15. Collaborates with the Loss Prevention Department on health and food safety standards, including proper food handling, sanitation, and cleanliness, so all restaurants are always prepared for health department inspections; reviews inspection results and drives follow-up with operations leaders.
16. Assists in the audit schedule for brand, safety, and health standards, ensuring findings are shared with operations leaders and every gap is closed.
17. Spends time in restaurants and on-site at select openings to model the OPEX culture, assess execution, and support operators.
18. Manages through the RVP’S the OPEX sustainability plan

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10 years of progressive multi-unit restaurant operations experience, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role required. Blend of Casual dining and QSR experience. Bar Experience needed. Airport concessions experience a plus
* Demonstrated success improving operational processes, leading change and implementing scalable programs
* Proven track record leading new restaurant openings, operational audit programs, and company-wide initiative rollouts.
* Demonstrated experience supporting restaurant openings, coaching, and developing managers and hourly associates
* Strong strategic planning and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and hold cross-functional teams accountable.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization and present to senior leadership.
* Advanced analytical skills; able to turn audit, scorecard, and performance data into clear insights and action plans.
* Strong understanding of financials, operational systems and data-driven decision making.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams) and restaurant technology systems, such as CrunchTime.
* Ability and willingness to travel frequently, including on-site support at select restaurant openings.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Ability and wiliness to travel 60% of the time with flexibility for extended travel during restaurant openings, rollouts and other business priorities.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the associate is regularly required to: stand for long periods of time, use hands and fingers, and be able to handle, feel, communicate verbally, and hear. The associate is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, climb, balance, taste and smell. The associate is also occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and either lift or move to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus. Be able to work in a standing position for long periods of time (up to 8hrs).

**EEOC Statement:**

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where employees feel empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability status, or veteran status.

**Summary**
**Job Description**
:
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement will support the AAI (Automotive, Aerospace, and Industrial) vertical. The services are primarily warehousing operations for distribution and inbound to manufacturing operations.
 
 
This position supports the Ryder Continuous Improvement culture across the Business Unit by actively promoting and facilitating the use of continuous improvement methods to support new and existing operations.
 
 
The Director will lead a team of CI Managers/Leads across the business to influence and drive change through data driven CI, Engineering, and Automation efforts to deliver higher levels of performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. Effectively leverage data analytics, engineering methodologies, and all Ryder lean tools to enable root cause identification and elimination.
 
 
This high influence position will interface with employees at all levels and functions across the business. This individual will work directly with his/her Operational peers in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities. This position directly reports to the Group or Senior Director of CI with dotted-line reporting to the assigned Groub Director/VP of Operations (Business Unit/Vertical). This individual will work directly with his/her peers and their direct reports in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities for new and existing operations.
 
 
**Essential Functions**

* Directs continuous improvement program and oversees engineering support functions .Supervise a team of continuous improvement Managers and quality professionals. Make employment decisions (hire, promote, coach, development) and manage performance. Develop CI Engineering bench to strategically support the BU/Vertical long term requirements. Manages and assigns CI resources for multiple and complex Supply Chain projects aligned with strategic and growth initiatives. Regularly interacts with Senior Management and/or customer(s).
* Aligns CI initiatives and project objectives to business strategy and prioritizes projects accordingly; includes key stakeholders in process, as required. Facilitate strategic planning (vertical blueprinting) and tactical process improvement events. Lead cross functional team to identify improvement opportunities and works with leadership to prioritize & plan initiatives. Present to executive leadership team on status and results of continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in regular business review session with VP of Operations, SCE team and Customers . Provide regular reports of data and actions to measure progress against strategic business objectives.
* Provide training, coaching, and mentoring: must be able to translate all Ryder Business System concepts and strategic objectives to local situations and help all levels of the organization develop understanding and application of tools for sustainable business improvements. Coach business owners to use Engineering, Data Analysis and Lean methods to achieve operational excellence. Support start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications.
* Work with vertical leaders to establish continuous improvement goals, and act as a liaison with finance to build continuous improvement budgets and validating actual improvement results. Develops, deploys and maintains account plans for assigned process areas designed to continually improve service offerings through the implementation of recognized engineering, quality, lean standards, continuous improvement strategies and demonstrated best practices. Manage monthly budget review process and financial reconciliation. Interfaces with senior level management to establish standard quality communications and action oriented forums (reviewing /analyzing operational performance, deploy policies and strategies, share best practices)
* Serve as the business owner, establish and regulate the standards for Quality Management Systems based on company and/or industry standards. * Effective facilitation and execution of Value Stream Maps & Kaizen Events through all stages (A3 charter creation, pre-work identification and completion, delivery of results, regular follow up and follow through on sustainment). Independently identifies process gaps and recommends and leads CI Team to implement process improvement. Manage, track, and report the progress and value of the transformational activities and projects across customer accounts. Direct the assessment, development, implementation, and continuous improvement activities related to the implementation of lean processes across accounts.

* Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards.
* Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system.
* Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements.
* Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion.
* Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification.
* Performs other duties as assigned

* Data visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) and database programming (SQL, DAX, etc.) intermediate preferred
* Expertise in developing and managing: Leader Standard Work, Visual Management Systems and Management Accountability Systems, Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S/Workplace Organization expert required
* Understanding and experience in core engineering and data analysis functions (slotting, utilization, labor planning, layouts, metrics, etc.) and warehouse design tools such as CAD (e.gAutoCAD); slotting (e.gSlot3D), Predetermined Motion and Time Systems and methods (e.gMOST); Warehouse Management Systems (e.gManhattan Scale), and Labor MgtSystems expert preferred
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management operations, data analytics, Industrial Engineering, warehouse types (ambient, temp control, warehouse layout/ design and Lean methods
* Knowledge of material handling solutions and automation types such as: powered industrial truck (PIT) applications; racking and other storage solution designs, packaging equipment; conveyor and sortation equipment; and other automation solutions (e.gAS/RS)expert required

**Summary**
**Job Description**
:
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement will support the AAI (Automotive, Aerospace, and Industrial) vertical. The services are primarily warehousing operations for distribution and inbound to manufacturing operations.
 
 
This position supports the Ryder Continuous Improvement culture across the Business Unit by actively promoting and facilitating the use of continuous improvement methods to support new and existing operations.
 
 
The Director will lead a team of CI Managers/Leads across the business to influence and drive change through data driven CI, Engineering, and Automation efforts to deliver higher levels of performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. Effectively leverage data analytics, engineering methodologies, and all Ryder lean tools to enable root cause identification and elimination.
 
 
This high influence position will interface with employees at all levels and functions across the business. This individual will work directly with his/her Operational peers in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities. This position directly reports to the Group or Senior Director of CI with dotted-line reporting to the assigned Groub Director/VP of Operations (Business Unit/Vertical). This individual will work directly with his/her peers and their direct reports in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities for new and existing operations.
 
 
**Essential Functions**

* Directs continuous improvement program and oversees engineering support functions .Supervise a team of continuous improvement Managers and quality professionals. Make employment decisions (hire, promote, coach, development) and manage performance. Develop CI Engineering bench to strategically support the BU/Vertical long term requirements. Manages and assigns CI resources for multiple and complex Supply Chain projects aligned with strategic and growth initiatives. Regularly interacts with Senior Management and/or customer(s).
* Aligns CI initiatives and project objectives to business strategy and prioritizes projects accordingly; includes key stakeholders in process, as required. Facilitate strategic planning (vertical blueprinting) and tactical process improvement events. Lead cross functional team to identify improvement opportunities and works with leadership to prioritize & plan initiatives. Present to executive leadership team on status and results of continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in regular business review session with VP of Operations, SCE team and Customers . Provide regular reports of data and actions to measure progress against strategic business objectives.
* Provide training, coaching, and mentoring: must be able to translate all Ryder Business System concepts and strategic objectives to local situations and help all levels of the organization develop understanding and application of tools for sustainable business improvements. Coach business owners to use Engineering, Data Analysis and Lean methods to achieve operational excellence. Support start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications.
* Work with vertical leaders to establish continuous improvement goals, and act as a liaison with finance to build continuous improvement budgets and validating actual improvement results. Develops, deploys and maintains account plans for assigned process areas designed to continually improve service offerings through the implementation of recognized engineering, quality, lean standards, continuous improvement strategies and demonstrated best practices. Manage monthly budget review process and financial reconciliation. Interfaces with senior level management to establish standard quality communications and action oriented forums (reviewing /analyzing operational performance, deploy policies and strategies, share best practices)
* Serve as the business owner, establish and regulate the standards for Quality Management Systems based on company and/or industry standards. Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification. Facilitate regular Performance Reviews with operations leadership and monitor metrics. Develop/implement strategy to manage scope and meet customer expectations. Support business start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications. Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards. Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system. Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements. Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion
* Effective facilitation and execution of Value Stream Maps & Kaizen Events through all stages (A3 charter creation, pre-work identification and completion, delivery of results, regular follow up and follow through on sustainment). Independently identifies process gaps and recommends and leads CI Team to implement process improvement. Manage, track, and report the progress and value of the transformational activities and projects across customer accounts. Direct the assessment, development, implementation, and continuous improvement activities related to the implementation of lean processes across accounts.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards.
* Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system.
* Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements.
* Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion.
* Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Skills And Abilities**

* Microsoft Office Suite skills with emphasis on Access, Excel and PowerPoint & Visioexpert required
* Data visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) and database programming (SQL, DAX, etc.) intermediate preferred
* Expertise in developing and managing: Leader Standard Work, Visual Management Systems and Management Accountability Systems, Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S/Workplace Organization expert required
* Understanding and experience in core engineering and data analysis functions (slotting, utilization, labor planning, layouts, metrics, etc.) and warehouse design tools such as CAD (e.gAutoCAD); slotting (e.gSlot3D), Predetermined Motion and Time Systems and methods (e.gMOST); Warehouse Management Systems (e.gManhattan Scale), and Labor MgtSystems expert preferred
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management operations, data analytics, Industrial Engineering, warehouse types (ambient, temp control, warehouse layout/ design and Lean methods
* Knowledge of material handling solutions and automation types such as: powered industrial truck (PIT) applications; racking and other storage solution designs, packaging equipment; conveyor and sortation equipment; and other automation solutions (e.gAS/RS)expert required
* Knowledge of Dedicated Services and Managed Transportation Networks
* Knowledge of all available equipment types such as; dry van, temperature control, flat bed, other specialized equipment
* Transportation Design Tools ie; JDA, Appian, Network Design Tools ie; Llamasoft, Transportation Management Systems ie; JDA, OTM, , Mapping Software ie; Tableau expert required
* Knowledge working with HRM systems (e.gWorkday) and associated HR processes
* Knowledge on team member hiring/on-boardingKnowledge of goal setting and performance management/resolutionadvanced preferred

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required Engineering, Business, Supply Chain
* Master's degree preferred Supply Chain Management or Industrial Engineering
* Ten (10) years or more Fourteen (14) yrs or more in the Distribution, Warehousing and/or Manufacturing, Transportation, Supply Chain Logistics industry required
* Microsoft Office Suite skills with emphasis on Access, Excel and PowerPoint & Visio. expert required
* Data visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) and database programming (SQL, DAX, etc.) intermediate preferred
* Expertise in developing and managing: Leader Standard Work, Visual Management Systems and Management Accountability Systems, Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S/Workplace Organization expert required
* Understanding and experience in core engineering and data analysis functions (slotting, utilization, labor planning, layouts, metrics, etc.) and warehouse design tools such as CAD (e.g. AutoCAD); slotting (e.g. Slot3D), Predetermined Motion and Time Systems and methods (e.g. MOST); Warehouse Management Systems (e.g. Manhattan Scale), and Labor Mgt. Systems. expert preferred
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management operations, data analytics, Industrial Engineering, warehouse types (ambient, temp control, warehouse layout/ design and Lean methods. Knowledge of material handling solutions and automation types such as: powered industrial truck (PIT) applications; racking and other storage solution designs, packaging equipment; conveyor and sortation equipment; and other automation solutions (e.g. AS/RS). expert required
* Knowledge of Dedicated Services and Managed Transportation Networks. Knowledge of all available equipment types such as; dry van, temperature control, flat bed, other specialized equipment. Transportation Design Tools ie; JDA, Appian, Network Design Tools ie; Llamasoft, Transportation Management Systems ie; JDA, OTM, , Mapping Software ie; Tableau. expert required
* Knowledge working with HRM systems (e.g. Workday) and associated HR processes. Knowledge on team member hiring/on-boarding. Knowledge of goal setting and performance management/resolution. advanced preferred
* Lean Six Sigma, required
* American Production Inventory Control Society (APICS) and/or Supply Chain Logistics Certification is preferred
* cPMP, ISO/QMS, preferred

**Travel**
- 50% - 70% (Eastern and Central time zones)
 
 
This position is remote, when you are not traveling.
 
 
**Job Category:**
Continuous Improvement
 
 
**Our Culture & Commitment**
At Ryder, you’re trusted to make an impact—while enjoying room to grow and having a voice that’s heard. Our culture is built on respect, collaboration, and shared pride in doing great work rooted in innovation and safety.
 
 
Your Voice. Your Success. The Future We Build Together.
 
 
**Compensation Information**
The compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience; education, including relevant degrees or certifications; work location; market data/ranges; internal equity; internal salary ranges; etc. The position may also be eligible to receive an annual bonus, commission, and/or long-term incentive plan based on the level and/or type. Compensation ranges for the position are below:
 
 
**Pay Type**
Salaried
 
 
**Minimum Pay Range**
160,000
 
 
**Maximum Pay Range**
180,000
 
 
**Benefits Information**
**For all Full-time positions only**
: Ryder offers comprehensive health and welfare benefits, to include medical, prescription, dental, vision, life insurance and disability insurance options, as well as paid time off for vacation, illness, bereavement, family and parental leave, and a tax-advantaged 401(k) retirement savings plan.
 
 
Ryder is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free workplace.
 
 
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
 
 
**Important Note**
Some positions require additional screening that may include employment and education verification; motor vehicle records check and a road test; and/or badging or background requirements of the customer to which you are assigned.
 
 
**Security Notice For Applicants**
Ryder will only communicate with an applicant directly from a [@ryder.com] email address and will never conduct an interview online through a chat type forum, messaging app (such as WhatsApp or Telegram), or via an online questionnaire. During an interview, Ryder will never ask for any form of payment or banking details and will never solicit personal information outside of the formal submitted application through www.ryder.com/careers .
 
 
Should you have any questions regarding the application process or to verify the legitimacy of an interview or Ryder representative, please contact Ryder at careers@ryder.com or 800-793-3754.

If you are a current employee at Ryder, please click here (https://wd5.myworkday.com/ryder/d/task/2998$46522.htmld) to log in to Workday to apply using the internal application process.

card.title: Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch
card.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.
 
 
With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.
 
 
**LOCATION:**
Remote with Travel
 
 
US Valve is growing rapidly, driven by critical customer demand in data center and other high-growth markets, creating increasingly complex new product development programs with multiple manufacturing paths. The Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch will build and lead the function responsible for taking these programs from business case through stable production, whether manufactured at US Valve, at sister IDEX business units, through external supply chain partners, or through a hybrid model. The role ensures that product design, manufacturing processes, suppliers, supply chain, quality systems, and commercial launch mature together against one integrated plan.
 
 
This leader is the single point of accountability for integrated NPI execution and owns end-to-end program results, including schedule, budget, quality, supplier readiness, manufacturing readiness, launch readiness, and ramp performance. The role organizes Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Sales, Finance, BU partners, and external suppliers under one plan. The Director ensures APQP and launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections, are completed on time and to standard. Success isn't design release; it is demonstrating that the full value stream can repeatedly meet customer demand with the required quality, cost, and delivery performance.
 
 
The right leader is a builder and results driver with the technical and operational credibility to walk the factory floor, challenge supplier capacity, identify manufacturing constraints, and lead cross-functional recovery. This person establishes the PMO, sets objective gate criteria and metrics, holds functional leaders and partners accountable without direct authority, challenges unrealistic plans, and leads recovery when programs fall behind. The leader will model IDEX values of trust, team, and excellence and build a high-performing team that scales with the business.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

**Job Summary**:

The Plant Manager oversees **PAFCO**’s processing, warehousing, and distribution operations, ensuring strong performance in production, food safety, regulatory compliance, labor management, and financial results. The ideal candidate has experience in seafood or perishable food manufacturing, strong operational expertise, and proven leadership skills in a fast-paced, temperature-controlled environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily seafood processing, warehousing, and distribution operations to meet production, quality, and service goals.
* Develop production schedules based on customer demand, inventory, and supply requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement to increase efficiency, reduce waste, and minimize downtime.
* Monitor production, labor, inventory, and cost KPIs to ensure operational performance.
* Oversee refrigerated and frozen warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, and outbound shipping.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP, SQF/GFSI, FSMA, FDA, USDA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Lead food safety audits, sanitation programs, corrective actions, and regulatory inspections.
* Manage equipment maintenance, facility infrastructure, and capital improvement projects.
* Own the plant budget, forecasting, cost controls, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Lead and develop supervisors, leads, and production employees across multiple shifts.
* Partner with HR on recruiting, workforce planning, performance management, and training.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* 7–10 years of progressive plant or operations management experience in food manufacturing; seafood or perishable proteins preferred.
* Proven experience managing multi-shift operations, budgets, P&L, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Experience with WMS, ERP, and production scheduling systems.
* HACCP certification required; SQF Practitioner or PCQI preferred.
* Working knowledge of FDA/FSMA, COOL, OSHA, and cold-chain requirements.
* Familiarity with industrial refrigeration systems and temperature-controlled operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and KPI-driven decision-making skills.
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a diverse, multi-shift workforce.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively on the production floor and with senior leadership.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant operational leadership experience will be considered.

**Benefits**

* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Disability insurance
* Paid vacation leave
* 401k with employee matching

**Employment Eligibility**

card.title: Director, Supply Chain Quality
card.description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.
 
 
AES has been **ranked #1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.**
 
 
We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. 
 
If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director – Supply Chain Quality will establish and lead the Supply Chain Quality program within the Strategic Sourcing function. Reporting to the Vice President of Strategic Sourcing, this position will be responsible for developing AES strategy and processes to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of owner-furnished equipment supporting the AES Renewables & Power business. This role will serve as the primary interface between Strategic Sourcing and internal teams such as Engineering, Execution, Operations, and our primary suppliers to proactively manage quality risk, improve supplier performance, and drive continuous improvement throughout the equipment lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will be capable of coordinating and collaborating with multiple teams across AES and take responsibility for ensuring the successful improvement of supplier performance across our equipment pipeline. Prior experience in Supply Chain Quality in renewables, gas and/or power sector strongly preferred.

This position will be ideally based in Louisville, CO. AES provides a flexible working environment, and remote work is possible with approval of location. Travel will also be required (~50%) 
 
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement the company’s supply chain quality strategy, standards, and governance processes
* Lead supplier qualification, factory audits, manufacturing surveillance, inspections, testing, and corrective action programs for major equipment suppliers.
* Oversee quality assurance activities for solar modules, battery energy storage systems, inverters, transformers, wind equipment, gas turbines, and other critical project components.
* Participate in and support Strategic Sourcing Category Managers with regular supplier meetings, including Quarterly Business Reviews, with quality-related updates and reviews
* Identify and mitigate supplier quality, manufacturing, and reliability risks that could impact project cost, schedule, safety, or operational performance.
* Partner with Engineering, Construction, Procurement, and Operations teams to resolve quality issues and incorporate lessons learned into future sourcing strategies and design/specification practices.
* Manage third-party quality service providers supporting audits, inspections, production monitoring, and testing activities.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, delivery performance, and defect reduction.
* Create data-driven systems to track and manage all activities and progress
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and warranty recovery efforts related to equipment failures and field performance issues.
* Maintain strong vendor relationships and represent the company’s values, quality expectations, and culture in all supplier interactions.
* Other job‑related duties and projects as assigned.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Engineering degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
* 10+ years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, supplier quality, manufacturing, or major‑equipment oversight within renewable energy, electrical equipment, EPC, or related industries
* 2+ years managing a team
* Technical knowledge of solar modules, inverters, racking, transformers, HV equipment, wind equipment, and/or battery energy storage systems
* Demonstrated success working to develop consensus from diverse opinions in a highly fluid and sometimes ambiguous multi-cultural environment
* Experience conducting or managing factory audits, FATs, certification testing, and supplier qualification activities
* Proficient with MS Office suite, Quickbase, Power BI and other software systems and analytical tools
* Experience building dashboarding and reporting metrics, and establishing those within a company’s system of record
* Familiarity and willingness to use AI tools and platforms to support work and reporting
* Understanding of and experience with SAP or similar ERP systems
* Quality certifications (ASQ, Six Sigma, ISO Auditor)

Respecting all backgrounds, differences and perspectives enables us to improve the lives of our people, customers, suppliers, contractors, and the communities in which we live and work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and/or expression, race, national origin, ethnicity, age, religion, marital status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. -------------------

The Global Director of Operations provides strategic and functional leadership for manufacturing operations across multiple sites and regions. This role develops and executes operational strategies to deliver world-class performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction while supporting business growth and long-term competitiveness.

The Global Director leads and influences across Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Materials and Logistics, Capital and Capacity Management, and digital manufacturing. This leader drives operational excellence through the Eaton Business System, continuous improvement, integrated planning, technology enablement, and development of high-performing teams. 
 
**Essential Responsibilities:** 

* Develop and execute the global operations strategy in alignment with business objectives, annual profit plan commitments, growth priorities, and customer requirements.
* Provide strategic and functional leadership across global manufacturing operations to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead manufacturing capacity, utilization, capital investment, and footprint strategies to support current business requirements and future growth.
* Drive Integrated Operations across Manufacturing Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Materials and Logistics, Capital and Capacity Management, and SIOP/S&OE.
* Establish key performance indicators and operating rhythms to monitor operational and financial performance and drive accountability for results.
